facebook.description: SNAP ego-Facebook: anonymised friendship circles, each undirected edge listed once

enron.description: SNAP email-Enron: email communication network, undirected, each edge stored in both directions

epinions.description: SNAP soc-Epinions1: who-trusts-whom network, directed (source trusts target)

lesmis.description: Les Miserables character co-appearance network (Knuth), undirected, weight = number of chapters in which the two characters co-appear
lesmis.edge_semantics: co-appearance in a chapter (symmetric); weight is a strength, not a distance
